title: Crew Roster
story:
The roster has to list the crew by age, youngest first. Crew with the **same age keep the order they were given in**.

Input: `N` (1–50), then N lines, each `name age` (name: 1–19 letters, age: 0–150).

Output: N lines, `name age`, sorted by age.

Example input `3`, `Mira 31`, `Jon 25`, `Ada 40` prints `Jon 25`, `Mira 31`, `Ada 40`.

tests.stdin:
6
Kai 0
Lu 150
Max 0
Ned 75
Oz 150
Pia 75
tests.expected:
Kai 0
Max 0
Ned 75
Pia 75
Lu 150
Oz 150

hints: Sort the array of structs. You can swap whole structs with `=`: `Crew t = crew[i]; crew[i] = crew[j]; crew[j] = t;`.
Insertion sort keeps equal ages in their original order: take each record and slide it left past records with a **strictly greater** age.
Bubble sort works too, as long as you only swap when `crew[j].age > crew[j + 1].age` (never on equal ages).
